failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A combined Method Flow and final-owner-manifest display truncated before both immutable documents were attributable through EOF.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Read the documents separately in bounded slices and included both in the exact Git-blob EOF verifier.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Do not claim a combined large projection complete unless every selected blob has an attributable EOF witness.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first bulk packet EOF verifier returned no attributable output within its observation window.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Used one bounded explicit UTF-8 Git-blob reader that emitted counts, parses, skill reads, manifest parity, seals, and final-line attribution.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Require a persisted or returned completion summary before crediting a bulk read.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A combined Git lifecycle preflight supplied an invalid value to a short option and returned an option-parsing error.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Repeated only the read-only lifecycle evidence as separate scalar Git probes.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Keep branch, ancestry, parent, merge, divergence, status, and remote probes as typed scalar commands.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A broad external-receipt search returned no attributable result within its bounded observation window.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Reread the exact predecessor task, used its literal receipt location, and verified both receipt digests directly.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Prefer an attributable literal receipt path from the exact source closeout over a broad archive search.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first exact predecessor-task reread requested an unsupported output bound and was rejected before returning task content.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Retried only the read with the supported maximum output bound.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Keep task reread bounds at or below the tool's documented maximum.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The supported three-turn predecessor-task reread still truncated before all projected turns were attributable.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Reduced the projection to the single terminal turn needed for the exact receipt path and post-final overlay evidence.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Use the smallest turn projection that establishes the specific predecessor fact.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A multi-term candidate-practice scan crossed its bounded observation window after partial output.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Used a smaller literal term set and selected only a practice with zero reachable keyword hits.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Bound candidate scans by one practice and a small exact term set before broader semantic comparison.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first lane-creation preflight placed a statement separator inside a parenthesized PowerShell expression and failed parsing before mutation.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Materialized the command exit code separately and reran only the read-only preflight.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Assign native-command results before embedding them in PowerShell expressions.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The worktree-creation wrapper crossed its observation window after the exact branch and worktree had already been created.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Inspected the literal path, process state, locks, branch, head, and sparse metadata before deciding not to repeat creation.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: After any wrapper timeout, inspect persisted Git and filesystem state before repeating a mutation.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The initial sparse checkout materialized no owner files but left all 11,687 inherited paths as index deletion rows.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Kept the exact owner-only sparse specification and diagnosed index materialization without deleting or resetting the lane.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Require both intended materialization and zero status rows after sparse setup.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A sparse-checkout reapply returned success while the 11,687 deletion rows remained unchanged.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Ran the narrow Git index materialization recovery, which restored skip-worktree state and produced zero status rows.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Treat a zero return code as insufficient when postcondition probes still fail; validate status and skip-worktree counts explicitly.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first x1 builder wrapper crossed its observation window while the attributable process was still performing read-only historical Git-blob scans.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Waited on the same process, observed its child Git reads, and verified that it completed once with the thirteen planning artifacts present.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Use a resumable session or an observation window sized for the bounded source-tree audit, and never duplicate a still-running builder.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A premature full x1 test-module selection ran before the staged-review receipt existed and failed one of thirteen tests with a missing-file error.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Retained the failure, selected only lifecycle-valid pre-stage checks, and reserved the staged-review test for after exact indexing and receipt generation.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Separate pre-stage planning checks from staged-index checks and run each only in its declared lifecycle context.
